build_mask_rcnn_config: build a mask r-cnn model config with resnet-50 backbone and fpn for coco instance segmentation
configure_detectron2_wrapper: configure a detectron2 wrapper model with generalised r-cnn architecture and frozen bn normalization
setup_rpn_proposal_generator: setup an rpn proposal generator with standard rpn head and iou thresholds for object detection
configure_roi_heads_mask_rcnn: configure roi heads with fast r-cnn conv fc box head and mask rcnn conv upsample mask head
define_anchor_generator_settings: define anchor generator settings with default sizes and aspect ratios for multi-scale feature pyramid
